correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives autonomous positive LV coordinates and a conserved strictly convex coercive energy. Every positive nonzero energy orbit is a regular compact Jordan level carrying nonzero tangent flow, hence periodic. Restricting energy to v=gamma and v=b+h yields unique minima and exactly two transverse intersections above each threshold; equality only touches. The original observables have periodic positive amplitudes times exp(-a t), which rigorously produces exact geometric peak heights. Standard-library RK4 check supports one witness only, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source has a general peak stationarity identity and low-knot log-transmission interpolation, but no exact exponential-forcing Lotka--Volterra invariant or two energy thresholds; the closest CoSIR paper uses an adaptive feedback rule, giving different observables. The standard Lotka--Volterra energy and periodicity are not new; their new use to give two sharp strict-peak thresholds plus exact geometric physical peak-height laws answers the source's unresolved structural low-forcing peak-capacity question. Primary full-text and targeted published-finding corpus/public searches found no covering statement, subject to unindexed-equivalence risk.
residual_risks: The idea of integrating exponentially increasing transmission could appear as an unindexed reduction in the older control/epidemic literature.
Classical conservative Lotka--Volterra orbit geometry is established, so novelty concerns the SIR-specific quantitative statement rather than the phase portrait itself.
The 1983 LV period reference was inspected via citation, not its original full text; it could not by itself establish the SIR specialized thresholds.

value.rationale: The motivated 2026 peak-preserving SIR problem distinguishes raw peak count from useful wave geometry. The theorem gives a sharp analytic classification of infinite raw peaks under strictly monotone one-slope transmission (two log-knots), an exact amplitude decay ratio, and a reason fixed positive prominence eliminates the apparent infinite wave complexity. This answers a natural low-dimensional forcing capacity boundary not provided by inverse representability or numerical MPPC fitting.
